Graph libraries for the score map (views/session-map.jade), served locally so
the map loads on a venue network with no internet access. Pinned; to upgrade,
replace the file from the same path at the new version and re-test the map.

| File | Package | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cytoscape.min.js | cytoscape 3.34.3 (MIT) | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cytoscape@3.34.3/dist/cytoscape.min.js |
| dagre.min.js | dagre 0.8.5 (MIT) | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dagre@0.8.5/dist/dagre.min.js |
| cytoscape-dagre.js | cytoscape-dagre 2.5.0 (MIT) | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cytoscape-dagre@2.5.0/cytoscape-dagre.js |
